name: offer-toolkit-skill
title_zh: 从岗位搜索到薪资谈判的六段式求职流水线
tagline_zh: 不是又一个简历模板合集。它把求职拆成六个独立工序，从批量找岗位到谈 package 都有专属子技能。
tagline_en: Not another resume template pack. Six independent sub-skills route any job query—LinkedIn sourcing, JD decoding.
desc_en: 求职工具包。把「找岗位 → 签 offer」拆成六个独立子 skill：⓪ Job Hunt 批量发现岗位，① Job Description 解码具体 JD，② Resume 定向简历，③ BQ 准备行为面试，④ Offer Compare 对比多份 offer，⑤ Salary Negotiation 谈 package。任何求职相关请求（找工作、该不该投、改简历、准备面试、选 offer、谈薪）都从这里进，再路由到对应子 skill。关键词：求职, offer, career, job hunt, LinkedIn jobs, JD, resume, CV, behavioral interview, BQ, STAR, offer compare, salary negotiation, 薪资谈判, 选 offer。
why_zh: 六个子技能各自独立又首尾衔接，路由自动分流。JD 解码不泛泛而谈，offer 对比落到数字。
why_en: Each sub-skill is standalone yet chainable, with automatic routing. JD decoding goes beyond generic advice, offer comparison.
limit_zh: 只覆盖求职主流程，不含简历排版美化、面试模拟对话、背调准备。子技能间需按顺序调用。
limit_en: Covers core job search only—no resume design, mock interviews, or reference checks. Sub-skills must run in order; skipping JD decoding before resume.
title_en: Six-stage job search pipeline: from sourcing to salary.
